description: Config 2 eval-fresh-gap (docs/demo/SIMSTACK-CONFIGS-SPEC.md §2.2) — a brand-new, competently-built CUI enclave. Block-untrusted-locations (P2) and admin-MFA (P3) were configured correctly and CMMC-named on day one, but the two policies teams most often forget — idle session termination (P1 AC.L2-3.1.11) and non-local maintenance MFA (P5 MA.L2-3.7.5) — were never stood up, so both read unknown at seed. No drift, no decoys: the confounder-free control that isolates the unknown->met flip mechanic. Mirror of Config 1 (decoy-maze asks does Muster OVER-credit?; this asks does Muster UNDER-credit?). caPolicies:2 holds exactly the two correctly-named policies; user-5 disabled so PS.L2-3.9.2 reads met on both the eq-filter-honored and passthrough paths; default users (5) and cross-tenant policy (1) kept so IA.L2-3.5.5/6 (P7) and AC.L1-3.1.20 (P9) read met and the plan's user-2/group-1 captures resolve. BEFORE-truth carried in expected_discovery; the calibrated AFTER-truth (P1/P5 flip to met, all gated probes met except N1/N2) is a live-calibrated inline map owned by the Integrate phase in e2e-configs.ts, never hand-authored here.

P3 AC.L2-3.1.15 admin-MFA CA -> met BEFORE (correctly named on day one; verbatim name from t2/t4)
